reason: The landlord said he would do the work himself (event-7, event-10). On 6 Sept he claimed it was completed on 31 August (event-12) and added details about the sockets and a dehumidifier (event-14). This is only a claim. It gives no description of the alarm replacement, no contractor or certificate, and no evidence that the ceiling opening was closed. The tenant removed the alarm (event-1) and has not been heard from since 20 Aug. We told her we would check back on completion (event-9), so that promise is still open. I cannot close on the landlord's word alone. The tenant is the party who can confirm that a working alarm is fitted and the sockets are fixed, so I asked her (message-1). The property and landlord match the job, and no provider or invoice is involved, so there is no money or mismatch issue. I did not escalate because nothing shows danger or a dispute. A missing smoke alarm is a compliance concern, but the landlord reports it fixed, and the tenant never reported an immediate risk. The recorded alarm detail is still unverified. If the tenant says the alarm is still missing, or the sockets are still loose, or there is damp, I would escalate. The kitchen socket issue after boiler work in February and the dehumidifier/bathroom damp are possible separate issues to follow up.
message: Dear Nessa, the landlord has told us he completed the work at 8 Brindlefern Walk on 31 August. Before we update our record, please could you confirm the following: (1) Is a working smoke alarm now fitted on the upstairs landing, and is the opening in the ceiling closed? (2) Have the loose plug sockets been fixed, including the kitchen and back bedroom, or are any still coming away from the wall? (3) Did you receive a portable dehumidifier for the bathroom, and is there any damp or mould there? If any alarm is missing or a socket is still loose, please tell us and we will follow it up. Kind regards, Ivo Merrick, Northbridge Lettings
unknowns: Whether a working smoke alarm is fitted and the ceiling opening closed
Whether all loose sockets are secured
Whether there is bathroom damp or mould
Who did the work and whether any certificate exists
request: The smoke alarm on the upstairs landing kept beeping despite attempts to stop it. The tenant removed it, and a small opening remains in the ceiling where it was fitted.
unrelated_issues: Loose plug sockets (kitchen and back bedroom) reported alongside the alarm
Possible bathroom damp, with a dehumidifier supplied by the landlord on 6 August
